target_name: Serial Issuance Against a Research Peak
rationale: This is essentially the archived "Proceeds-Into-Research Issuance" with the issuance horizon stretched from one to three years and the expected sign silently flipped to match that signal's realized (contrary-to-hypothesis) outcome — a post-hoc sign reversal on a near-duplicate construction, and multi-year net issuance is itself the well-documented composite-issuance anomaly.

A defensible repair of the gen-0 SIGN-based productivity signal — the bounded non-negative rank weight is internally consistent with the negative expected sign and preserves trend information the SIGN operator discarded — though the mechanism remains an issuance anomaly with a conditioning variable and coverage will stay near 4% among R&D reporters with three-year trends.

This is the arithmetic product of two separately published anomalies (Novy-Marx gross profitability and net share issuance/repurchase), so the spread will be dominated by their main effects rather than any interaction, and gross-margin-on-assets is a weak stand-in for "intangible franchise" — the intangible theme is essentially absent from the expression.

Cleanly separates acquired from organic intangible capital as the conditioning variable, is internally consistent (signed issuance times a non-negative goodwill-intensity weight, negative sign), and improves coverage, though the COALESCE-to-zero convention creates a large tied mass at the bottom rank and the construction sits close to both the goodwill/acquisition and share-issuance literatures.

target_name: Industry-Neutral Financing Surplus Over Intangible Needs
rationale: The industry-contamination diagnosis is economically reasonable, but the edit is the archived gen-0 signal with a standard z-score swapped for an industry z-score and the intangible gate dropped — a normalization tweak rather than a substantively different mechanism, and removing the gate also removes the only conditional/cross-theme element.

The lead-lag structure (accumulated past issuance interacted with current intangible contraction) is genuinely distinct from the archive's contemporaneous pairings and the sign is coherent, but because both factors are non-negative the signal has a large degenerate mass at zero, so the long leg is an undifferentiated pool of non-issuers and the portfolio sort may be unstable.
